action_surge.name: Action Surge
action_surge.desc: 4 s of double-speed attacks; Bonus refreshes.

parry.name: Parry
parry.desc: Turn aside a telegraphed attack and stagger the attacker.

shove_every_third.name: Shoving Blows
shove_every_third.desc: Every 3rd hit shoves; Strength save or Prone.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: Explodes for fire damage, Dex save for half. Uses a spell slot.

grease.name: Grease
grease.desc: Hold Action: slick, flammable ground. Dex save or Prone.

arcane_recovery.name: Arcane Recovery
arcane_recovery.desc: Recover spell slots on a short rest.

sneak_strike.name: Sneak Attack
sneak_strike.desc: Lunge and strike; with advantage or a flanking ally, add Sneak Attack dice.

cunning_hide.name: Cunning Action: Hide
cunning_hide.desc: Hold Bonus: vanish. Your next attack has advantage.

uncanny_dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
uncanny_dodge.desc: Halve the damage of the telegraphed attack.

turn_undead.name: Turn Undead
turn_undead.desc: Undead within range: Wisdom save or Frightened and fleeing.

healing_word.name: Healing Word
healing_word.desc: Heal the most wounded ally in range; revives the downed.

spiritual_weapon.name: Spiritual Weapon
spiritual_weapon.desc: Hold Bonus: a floating weapon fights beside you and flanks.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.desc: Ward the targeted ally: attacker makes a Wisdom save or loses the attack.

reckless_strike.name: Reckless Strike
reckless_strike.desc: A huge swing with advantage; enemies have advantage on you for 4 s.

retaliation.name: Retaliation
retaliation.desc: Strike the attacker as it winds up.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.desc: Mark a foe: your hits deal +1d6.

evasive_step.name: Evasive Step
evasive_step.desc: Blink backwards out of the telegraph.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.desc: Thunder blast around you: Con save or pushed 3 m.

cutting_words.name: Cutting Words
cutting_words.desc: Subtract 1d8 from the telegraphed attack roll.

lay_on_hands.name: Lay on Hands
lay_on_hands.desc: Heal the nearest ally from a pool of 5 x level.

protection.name: Protection
protection.desc: Impose disadvantage on an attack against an ally near you.

hunger_of_hadar.name: Hunger of Hadar
hunger_of_hadar.desc: A sphere of darkness: blinds and chills.

hex.name: Hex
hex.desc: Curse a foe: your hits deal +1d6 necrotic.

hellish_rebuke.name: Hellish Rebuke
hellish_rebuke.desc: The attacker takes fire damage, Dex save for half.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.desc: Grasping roots: Strength save or Restrained.

thorn_ward.name: Thorn Ward
thorn_ward.desc: Reduce the incoming hit by 1d10 + Wis.
